mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, category, images, likes_count, comments_count, views_count, shares_count, image_count, cover_image, status, is_top, is_hot, exposure_score, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE status = 1 AND is_top = 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(likes_count, 0) * 0.5 + COALESCE(comments_count, 0) * 0.3 + COALESCE(views_count, 0) * 0.2 + COALESCE(exposure_score, 0)) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
